original_ai_output.title_zh: 几内亚比绍被罢黜总统被禁止回国引发不同反应
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 几内亚比绍军方以“安全条件”和维护公共秩序为由，禁止被罢黜总统乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛从流亡地返回。恩巴洛此前誓言将于周日回国并参加定于12月举行的总统选举。首都比绍居民对军政府的这一决定反应不一。

key_facts.fact: 几内亚比绍军方禁止被罢黜总统恩巴洛从流亡地返回
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the military junta's decision to bar the ousted president's return from exile

key_facts.fact: 军方以“安全条件”和维护公共秩序为由实施禁令
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Military leaders cited "security conditions" and the need to preserve public order for blocking his return.

key_facts.fact: 恩巴洛此前誓言周日回国并参加12月总统选举
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: former president Umaro Sissoco Embalo vowed he come back to the country on Sunday and contest the presidential election due to take place in December

key_facts.fact: 首都比绍居民对军方决定反应不一
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: There has been mixed reaction from residents in Guinea-Bissau's capital, Bissau

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
